title: mobevent
description: Controls what mob events are allowed to run.

event.title: event
event.description: Required. An `enum` that specifies the events to control or query. Must be one of the following: `minecraft:ender_dragon_event`, `minecraft:pillager_patrols_event`, `minecraft:wandering_trader_event`, or `events_enabled`.

value.title: value
value.description: Optional. A `Boolean` that enables events (`true`) or disables them (`false`). Default: `false`.
